geometry: Three translucent white vertical rectangular bars and two opaque horizontal rectangular crossbars, with square ends on a transparent 24 by 24 canvas. The vertical bars are 2 units wide, span y=2.5 to 20.5, and start at x=3, 10, and 17; the crossbars are 1.5 units high at y=5.75 and 13.75.
limitations: The source's antialiased bar intersections and subtly varying end coverage are approximated with simple overlapping rectangles. The 8x SVG rendering was visually inspected.
